Our FDA cleared, industry leading products are used by hundreds of thousands of clinicians on millions of patients around the world. With Eko, clinicians can detect cardiac and pulmonary disease with higher accuracy, diagnose with more confidence, manage treatment effectively, and ultimately give their patients the best care possible. We have strong venture capital backing from investors like Artis Ventures, Questa Capital, Highland Capital, and Mayo Clinic Ventures. Recognized by TIME magazine in 2025 as one of the world’s top healthcare technology companies, Eko is one of the fastest growing digital health companies with products used around the world at some of the most prestigious health systems. We have more than 8 FDA clearances including novel AI algorithms, and we invest heavily in quality clinical research and R&D to build and validate exceptional products for patients we care deeply about. We’ve built a mission driven, high performing, talented, and diverse team of engineers, physicians, PhD’s, creatives, and technologists. We are committed to investing in each other and our mission to ensure all patients have access to high quality care. We are headquartered in Emeryville, California and privately-held with world class investors and partners. Role Summary Eko Health builds devices and software

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description_text: About Us: Endpoint is an interactive response technology (IRT®) systems and solutions provider that supports the life sciences industry. Since 2009, we have been working with a single vision in mind, to help sponsors and pharmaceutical companies achieve clinical trial success. Our solutions, realized through the proprietary PULSE® platform, have proven to maximize the supply chain, minimize operational costs, and ensure timely and accurate patient dosing. Endpoint is headquartered in Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. Position Overview: As the first point of contact for prospective sponsors, CROs, and clinical research organizations, the Sales Development Representative will drive Endpoint Clinical's growth engine — identifying and engaging the right accounts, qualifying opportunities, and setting up the Business Development team for success.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Programmatic
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a driven and client-focused Programmatic Account Manager to join our US National team. You will manage a portfolio of brand direct and agency clients across our US Central region, acting as their primary point of contact from campaign kickoff through quarterly business reviews. You will combine strong programmatic expertise with a performance-first mindset to deliver measurable results, uncover growth opportunities, and strengthen long-term partnerships. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about delivering impactful, client-centric solutions. The listed salary range reflects the base salary for this role and is dependent on experience and qualifications. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for a variable incentive plan and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Programmatic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description_text: About the Role We're looking for a Programmatic Customer Success professional to join our Curation team and help grow a book of partners across the digital advertising ecosystem, including agencies, curation providers, supply-side partners, retail and commerce media networks, and data providers. This isn't a support-oriented role. You'll own day-to-day relationships and troubleshooting, but you'll also learn to think like a growth partner: understanding what makes each partner tick, spotting opportunities to expand the relationship, and helping partners get more value out of Equativ's Maestro platform over time. You don't need to be an expert in every part of programmatic advertising. We're looking for someone who has some exposure to digital advertising or AdTech, is curious and eager to learn, and genuinely enjoys building relationships and solving problems. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to build a foundation in programmatic advertising and curation, with room to grow into broader account ownership as our team and our partners' businesses scale. What You'll Do Own day-to-day relationships for a portfolio of partners, serving as a reliable point of contact for questions, requests, and troubleshooting. jobs.description_text: 👋 Hi! We are Equativ! Equativ is an AdTech leader created in 2001 on the belief that we can disrupt the on-line advertising industry. Headquartered in the heart of Paris and with offices in 19 countries, Equativ provides cutting-edge technologies that help hundreds of prestigious customers take back control and maximize their digital revenues with a flexible and transparent audience monetization platform. We can rely on a unique group of 700+ colleagues focused on excellence to shape our future. They continually embrace change and overcome challenges together to make innovation happen. That means we can offer you endless opportunities to do the same and let you shape the world you want! Equativ is looking for a proactive and strategic Sales Enablement Manager to join our Sales Enablement team. In this pivotal role, you will be the driving force behind our demand-side success across the APAC and MENA regions. You won't just be managing documents; you will be a key partner to our Sales teams, to plan, build, and continuously improve the collateral, tools and processes that help our sales teams win. By sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing, you will transform Equativ’s sophisticated tech capabilities into winning narratives that resonate with the world’s leading agencies and brands.

jobs.title: SVP, National Sales
jobs.description_text: About the Role Equativ is looking for an SVP, National Sales to lead and grow our U.S. national sales an organization spanning New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada. We're looking for a sales leader who knows the programmatic advertising space, has deep relationships across major holding companies and independent agencies, and has a track record of growing revenue and winning new business. Just as important: someone who knows how to lead people. Externally, you're the face of Equativ's national sales effort, credible with senior agency and holding company decision-makers, comfortable in the room for the biggest pitches, and always looking for whitespace and new opportunity. Internally, you're building and running the team and setting the bar, creating consistency across three regions, coaching leaders and reps, and making the organization sharper and more accountable than it was before you got there. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to stay close to the market and close to the team, and who's ready to shape how national sales operates, competes, and wins. What You'll Do Lead the National Sales Organization Lead the North American national sales team across New York, the Midwest, the West Coast, and Canada setting clear priorities and creating alignment on where and how we grow. jobs.title: Team Lead, Account Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Team Lead, Account Manager at Equativ, you’ll play a pivotal role in delivering best-in-class service to our clients while ensuring seamless execution of campaigns. Sitting at the intersection of client relationships, campaign management, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Operations to maximize client satisfaction and business growth. This is an opportunity to work hands-on at the front lines of digital advertising, supporting both direct and programmatic campaigns for some of the industry’s most innovative partners.

jobs.title: Technical Support, Manager, Americas
jobs.description_text: 👫 About the team Our highly dedicated Support team has both the art and the science for delivering customer satisfaction. People in the team share a passion for helping our clients to surpass their digital business goals. They grow in a demanding environment, combine technical and consultative skills and are ready to tackle the most complex challenges to empower our customers get the best of our platforms. Your Mission 👇 Based in São Paulo, the Technical Support Manager is part of our Global Technical Support Organization, supporting customers across all geographies and leading our Technical Support Specialists (TSS) in the Americas (Brazil, US, Canada). You will lead a team of technical support professionals who combine strong customer-facing skills with deep technical expertise. Your mission is to build a high-performing, autonomous and customer-focused team that delivers consistently high-quality technical support while continuously improving its technical, operational and customer management capabilities. You will also play a key role in evolving how we deliver Technical Support through AI, automation and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve customer response and enable TSS to troubleshoot and resolve issues more effectively. You will work closely with our global Support leadership team, as well as Sales, Services, Product and R&D teams, to resolve customer issues effectively and ensure customer feedback drives improvement

jobs.title: VP, Operations and Services
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The VP, Operations & Services is a newly created leadership role responsible for bringing together the teams that support our commercial organization and customers across Ad Operations, Traffic Management, Account Management, and Demand Optimization. This leader will be responsible for creating greater consistency across these teams and how they work together, how they partner with Sales, and how we support our clients from the point a deal is signed through delivery and ongoing account management. We're looking for someone who has led operations and client service teams within ad tech or digital media and understands both programmatic and direct advertising. This person should be comfortable leading at the executive level while staying close enough to the business to understand what's working, where teams are getting stuck, and what needs to change. Teams & Scope This role will oversee the following functions, either directly or through their respective leaders: Ad Operations — campaign setup, trafficking, creative QA, and delivery across direct and programmatic channels Traffic Management — inventory allocation, pacing, and campaign flow across our platforms and tools Account Management / Client Services — day-to-day client relationships, renewals, and post-sale support across advertisers, agencies, and publisher partners Demand Optimization — yield, pricing, and inventory optimization in support of revenue and partner goals What You'll Do Lead the Organization

Et puis nous avons continué... jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. You'll work closely with software developers, AI researchers, clinicians, and domain scientists to create validated models that answer challenging scientific and clinical questions. About the Projects: Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Much of Kitware’s work involves applying state-of-the-art artificial intelligence and mechanistic modeling approaches to dynamic, real-world problems. We consider the work that we do on our government contracts as one of the ways that we give back to the community. We partner with premier government R&D agencies such as DARPA, IARPA, ARPA-H, DHA, AFRL, Army C5ISR, NOAA, and other branches of the US Government on a range of efforts, including prime contracts, SBIRs, and STTRs. In addition, we provide commercial services to companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.
